statement: The observation uses the Yale scan of this panel of the foldout and the pinned ZL locus headers. Numbering runs left to right within the upper, middle and lower groups. The upper vessel is drawn as a continuous object with two labelled fields, so the entry uses the first locus f102v2.1, followed by continuation f102v2.2. The long horizontal ochre drawing below the middle group has an uncertain attachment at the stain and is recorded separately. A stain and wear obscure the surroundings of the lower-right drawing, leaving the association of f102v2.29 unresolved. Colours describe visible paint.
